summary:
Root owns recovery and the complete Home/Root/staging integration join; disjoint contributors retain clear touch-sets and the same integrator carries the selected path through acceptance. Preserve actual private baseline/successor custody outside disposable roots. Unavailable historical bytes and receipts stay unavailable. Missing enrollment fences board-derived selection, while independently authorized source and separately qualified Status work retain their guards. Preserve the first cache failure and locks; use isolated repair. Current owning issues reconcile reported supply, independent verification and accepted delivery without a second ledger.

Before another component series, inspect the entire selected production entry through authentication, payload, journal, output and cleanup against actual generated inputs. A workload dictionary is not executed code, and a method provided only by a Source external boundary is not an implemented native adapter. Build focused replay from actual failing wrapper/launcher/role distinctions and retain first-failure chronology. Compose lifecycle birth, held state, scope transition, execution, collection, lost replies and sequential reuse as one ownership/accounting contract. Do not label internal assembly defects external supply failures.

The28October direction prioritizes a bounded native Home path over expanding simulated OS behavior. Evaluate standard manager ownership and genuine operating-system boundaries before reproducing filesystem/process/systemd semantics. Require each custom parentage, gate or complete-observation rule to identify its actual failure model. Standard mechanisms still need explicit adapters for admission, exact artifacts and recovery. Select a versioned minimal production profile when wider historical role/workload requirements are not intrinsic to the first trace; preserve later qualification and never report synthetic success for omitted roles. Audit all affected producers, consumers, generated inputs and cleanup together when contracts change. Keep the current integrator; add workers only behind stable independent interfaces.

Replay and immutable-data batching preserve input hashes/contract versions and stage scope; final processes, reservations, clocks and cleanup are fresh. Empty command lines after exit do not prove argument drift, and kill status alone does not identify its source. Waits, PIDFD coldness, group absence, EOF and production cleanup have distinct scopes; later custody verification does not erase an earlier gap. Current issues carry substantive results, changed supplier facts and meaningful acceptance rather than unchanged polling or narration.

For non-functional prose, verify citations, links, archives and existing protected checks; keep unchanged advisory failures visible without unrelated repairs. Fetch the exact immutable Git object and verify bytes before diagnosing source absence; unavailable retrieval is not a missing-file finding. Preserve original evidence and explicit supersession. Complete fresh native trace plus precise remaining gaps and one frozen-whole review remain acceptance boundaries. These practices add no runtime grant, duplicate ledger, extra review chain, telemetry gate or measured-savings claim.
title: Use actual allocation and production interfaces with verified source evidence
